title: Fouche: the TR3B uses internal mass reduction

tellings.quote: cuz fuch was adamant that the TR3B is not anti-gravity. It's internal mass reduction. It's to reduce the weight the mass of the TR3B by I think 89%.

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb, on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2026, passes on the claims of Edgar Fouche, a man who said he worked on secret aircraft. Fouche said a secret triangle-shaped craft called the TR3B does not use anti-gravity but "internal mass reduction", a way of cutting the craft's weight by about 89 percent. If true, it would mean the US had built aircraft that could cancel most of their own mass.
